title: plugin-auth: admin import-users does not join created users to the importing admin's current organization in multi-org mode
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: class a, from the final report 6933432108 of card #33113 (PR #34531), passed on by area `o2-D`. Dedupe: `import-users organization`, `joinCurrentOrganization import`.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：多组织模式下，管理员在控制台单个新建用户时，新用户会加入管理员当前所在的组织;用 `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` 批量导入的用户不会。
- 后果：导入的用户不在这个组织里。导入文件带 `positions` 列时，每一行都会被成员资格校验拒绝(`VALIDATION_FAILED`,`user_id` `reference_not_found`)。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Evidence (re-check commands)

- `grep -n "joinCurrentOrganization" packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts`: create-user joins the current organization.
- `grep -n "joinCurrentOrganization\|createUser" packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`: import-users only calls `authApi.createUser` (no join).
- `reconcile-membership.ts` returns `none` in multi mode, so nothing joins the user later.

## Change

Make import-users go through the same membership step create-user uses, as one shared helper and not a second copy. Pin it with a multi-org test: an imported user is a member of the importing admin's current organization, and a `positions` row on it validates.

## Done when

The pin test passes in multi mode, and single-org mode behaviour is unchanged.
